  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VI Semester - End Semester Makeup Examination - June -2024  
  Agile Software Development for Engineers [IT-4308]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           How does Agile development promote adaptability and responsiveness to change  
  compared to traditional software development methodologies? Provide specific  
  (4)  
  examples from Agile practices.  
  A)  
  B)      Illustrate the steps used to transfer from traditional approach to agile process by  
  considering Education Sector for Curriculum Development and Adaptive Learning.                (3)  
  
  C)      Give the need of DevOps. Describe the Responsibilities, and Skills that is expected from  
  DevOps engineer                                                                          (3)  
  
  2)           What is site reliability engineering? Discuss the benefits of site reliability engineering  
  (SRE) practices.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      In what ways does the Kanban system assist in managing and optimizing workflow  
  within a team? Furthermore, what role do Work in Progress (WIP) limits play in this           (3)  
  process?  
  
  C)      Illustrate the process of scrum framework.                                                    (3)  
  3)           Illustrate how Agile teams achieve continuous delivery, and what benefits does it offer  
  in terms of speed, quality, and customer satisfaction?  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      In what ways can virtual meetings enhance the evaluation of Agile methodologies in  
  distributed startup teams?                                                                    (3)  
  
  C)      How does Agile handle requirements that change frequently during a project?                   (3)  
  4)           Illustrate how organizations combine Kanban and Agile practices to achieve a flexible  
  and adaptive approach to project and product development.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      How does Agile address quality assurance and testing practices?                               (3)

  how does it promote innovation and productivity?                                          (3)  
  
  5)              How does the agile principle "Working software over comprehensive documentation"  
  contribute to project success?  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)         Outline the potential challenges associated with implementing Test-Driven Development  
  (TDD) in a large, existing codebase? How can these challenges be mitigated?           (3)  
  
  C)         Discuss the Agile practice of "Pair Programming." What benefits does it offer, and how
